_comment: Warcraft proper nouns carry an apostrophe the TTS model reads as a possessive or a hard glottal stop, which is what made place names sound wrong. The fix is the smallest one that works: drop the apostrophe and let the two halves run together as a single word. Chosen by ear on 23 Aug 2026 against four alternatives, including full phonetic respelling.
_why_not_phonetic: An earlier version respelled these phonetically with hyphens -- Zul'Aman as Zool-Ah-Mahn. It was rejected on listening: every hyphen invites a micro-break, so a three-hyphen name is read as separate stressed pieces rather than one word, and the delivery turns choppy. Measured, hyphenation also lengthened clips ~5.8% and roughly doubled the count of small internal pauses.
_scope: Only names containing an apostrophe appear here. Words without one need no help and were removed -- respelling them was solving a problem that did not exist. English contractions are never touched, because they are not keys.
